template.name: seqdex/guarded-order

params.label: The asset the order sells, which the coin holds
params.name: ASSET_A

params.label: The asset a fill pays in
params.name: ASSET_B

params.label: Price numerator: RATE_NUM atoms of ASSET_B for every RATE_DEN atoms of ASSET_A
params.name: RATE_NUM

params.label: Price denominator: RATE_NUM atoms of ASSET_B for every RATE_DEN atoms of ASSET_A
params.name: RATE_DEN

params.label: Least a fill takes, and least a remainder holds, in ASSET_A
params.name: MIN_LOT

params.label: The maker's payout script, which every fill pays
params.name: MAKER

params.label: From this lock time the refund key may take the coin back: below 500,000,000 a block height, else a Unix time compared with the median time past
params.name: EXPIRY

params.label: The key that takes the coin back after EXPIRY
params.name: REFUND_KEY

params.label: The asset input 0 of every spend must hold, explicitly
params.name: GUARD_ASSET

params.label: How much of GUARD_ASSET input 0 must hold, exactly
params.name: GUARD_AMOUNT

paths.effect: Fills the order in part: output 2k pays MAKER at least ceil(fill x RATE_NUM / RATE_DEN) of ASSET_B, and output 2k+1 holds the remainder of ASSET_A, at least MIN_LOT, at this same script. The fill is at least MIN_LOT. Input 0 holds exactly GUARD_AMOUNT of GUARD_ASSET; this coin is input k, k at least 1. PATH is Left(true).
paths.name: fill

paths.effect: Fills the whole order: output 2k pays MAKER at least ceil(coin x RATE_NUM / RATE_DEN) of ASSET_B, and the coin is at least MIN_LOT. Output 2k+1 is the taker's. Input 0 holds exactly GUARD_AMOUNT of GUARD_ASSET; this coin is input k, k at least 1. PATH is Left(false).
paths.name: fill_whole

paths.effect: Once the transaction's lock time reaches EXPIRY, the refund key takes the coin, signing the whole transaction. PATH is Right(()). Input 0 holds exactly GUARD_AMOUNT of GUARD_ASSET, and this coin is not input 0.
paths.name: refund

template.summary: A SeqDEX resting order that moves only beside a guard coin at input 0: anyone fills it in part or in whole by paying the maker at the order's price, the rest resting again at the same script; after expiry the refund key takes it back. Every path needs exactly GUARD_AMOUNT of GUARD_ASSET at input 0, so an asset whose rules a covenant at input 0 enforces can rest in it.

fill.transaction: the guard coin, the order, a payment coin and a fee coin in a third asset; the guard's return, the taker's asset, the credit, the rest, the payment change, the fee change and the fee

fill_whole.transaction: the guard coin, the order, a payment coin and a fee coin; the guard's return, the taker's asset, the credit, the payment change, the fee change and the fee

refund.transaction: the guard coin, the order and a fee coin; the guard's return, the whole coin to the refund key's wallet, the fee change and the fee
